[strategy/guidance/security/Application/abbs/GUID-SEC-APP-ABB-SBOM-2.7.23.md#abb-context]

### ABB Context

- **Parent L2 Capability**: Software Supply Chain Security — [GUID-SEC-APP-CAP-DESC-1.7.02](../GUID-SEC-APP-CAP-DESC-1.7.02.md)
- **ABB Catalog**: [GUID-SEC-APP-ABB-CAT-2.7.06](../GUID-SEC-APP-ABB-CAT-2.7.06.md)
- **Capability Statement**: The enterprise SHALL have an architectural capability to generate, store, and make available a structured inventory of all software components — including direct dependencies and transitive inclusions — for every software artifact delivered to or operated by the enterprise.
page_texts.4:
[strategy/guidance/security/Application/abbs/GUID-SEC-APP-ABB-SBOM-2.7.23.md#abb-scope]

### ABB Scope

**In Scope**:
- Architectural capability to produce a machine-readable component inventory for each application build artifact
- SBOM storage, versioning, and association with specific artifact releases
- SBOM attestation — cryptographically binding the SBOM to the artifact it describes
- SBOM consumption for vulnerability correlation and regulatory disclosure purposes

**Out of Scope**:
- Vulnerability assessment of enumerated components (see GUID-SEC-APP-ABB-SCA-2.7.10, which feeds SBOM generation)
- Integrity verification of the build pipeline itself (see GUID-SEC-APP-ABB-DEPINT-2.7.24)
- Third-party vendor risk assessment (see GRC domain)
- Security controls, format mandates, or regulatory disclosure requirements (`standards/security/`)

[strategy/guidance/security/Application/abbs/GUID-SEC-APP-ABB-SBOM-2.7.23.md#core-principles]

### Core Principles

- An SBOM SHALL be generated for every software artifact produced by the enterprise build pipeline.
- SBOMs SHALL be stored and associated with the specific artifact version they describe; they SHALL NOT be overwritten when a new build is produced.
- SBOMs SHOULD be cryptographically signed to establish an attestable link between the inventory and the artifact.
- SBOMs SHALL be consumable by automated tooling for vulnerability correlation; human-readable formats are a secondary consideration.
page_texts.8:
[strategy/guidance/security/Application/abbs/GUID-SEC-APP-ABB-SBOM-2.7.23.md#sbom-generation]

#### SBOM Generation

**Architectural intent**: Produce a complete, accurate inventory of all components that constitute a delivered software artifact.

**Design guidance**:
- SBOM generation SHALL be provided as a platform-operated service, not as a capability that individual application teams configure within their own pipeline definitions. Platform Engineering owns the SBOM generation infrastructure; development teams are consumers of the output.
- The platform SBOM service SHALL be triggered automatically by artifact publication events (e.g., image pushed to registry) without requiring development team action; it is a post-build platform concern, not an application build concern.
- Artifacts without a corresponding SBOM SHALL be treated as unattested and SHOULD be blocked by admission control.
- The generated SBOM SHALL cover direct and transitive dependencies across all language ecosystems present in the artifact.
- SBOM format SHOULD follow an established open standard to enable interoperability with consuming tools and regulatory disclosure requirements.
page_texts.9:
[strategy/guidance/security/Application/abbs/GUID-SEC-APP-ABB-SBOM-2.7.23.md#sbom-storage-and-association]

#### SBOM Storage and Association

**Architectural intent**: Maintain SBOMs as first-class artifacts associated with the software versions they describe.

**Design guidance**:
- SBOMs SHALL be stored in a location accessible to authorized consuming systems and teams.
- Each SBOM SHALL be associated with the specific artifact version (build ID, image digest, release tag) it describes.
- SBOM storage SHOULD be integrated with the artifact registry to enable discovery alongside the artifact.
page_texts.10:
[strategy/guidance/security/Application/abbs/GUID-SEC-APP-ABB-SBOM-2.7.23.md#sbom-attestation]

#### SBOM Attestation

**Architectural intent**: Provide cryptographic assurance that an SBOM was produced by an authorized build process and has not been modified.

**Design guidance**:
- SBOMs SHOULD be signed using build pipeline identity credentials managed through GUID-SEC-APP-ABB-VAULT-2.7.21.
- Attestation signatures SHOULD be verifiable by downstream consumers without requiring access to the signing key material.
page_texts.11:
[strategy/guidance/security/Application/abbs/GUID-SEC-APP-ABB-SBOM-2.7.23.md#integration-interfaces]

### Integration Interfaces

| Interface | Direction | Consuming ABB | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Build Artifact | Inbound | CI/CD Pipeline | Build artifact submitted for component enumeration |
| SCA Findings | Inbound | GUID-SEC-APP-ABB-SCA-2.7.10 | Component inventory data from software composition analysis |
| SBOM Output | Outbound | Artifact Registry / SBOM Store | Generated and signed SBOM associated with artifact |
| Vulnerability Correlation | Outbound | SecOps / Vulnerability Management | SBOM consumed for ongoing vulnerability matching |
page_texts.12:
[strategy/guidance/security/Application/abbs/GUID-SEC-APP-ABB-SBOM-2.7.23.md#zero-trust-alignment-nist-sp-800-207]

### Zero Trust Alignment (NIST SP 800-207)

SBOM advances the Applications and Workloads pillar by establishing the identity of the components that constitute a workload — a prerequisite for making trust decisions about that workload. You cannot verify what you cannot enumerate.
page_texts.13:
[strategy/guidance/security/Application/abbs/GUID-SEC-APP-ABB-SBOM-2.7.23.md#nist-sp-800-53-intent-alignment]

### NIST SP 800-53 Intent Alignment

This ABB enables the architectural intent of the SA (System and Services Acquisition) family — specifically software supply chain risk management and component inventory — and the CM (Configuration Management) family, which addresses the tracking of software components and authorized configurations.
page_texts.14:
[strategy/guidance/security/Application/abbs/GUID-SEC-APP-ABB-SBOM-2.7.23.md#constraints-and-dependencies]

### Constraints and Dependencies

- SBOM completeness depends on build system integration; builds that pull dependencies from sources not covered by the SBOM generator will produce incomplete inventories.
- SBOM attestation signing depends on GUID-SEC-APP-ABB-VAULT-2.7.21 for key management.
- This ABB receives component data from GUID-SEC-APP-ABB-SCA-2.7.10 and provides inventory data to vulnerability management processes.
